# Finca Los Collados de San Miguel

Rural estate in Villamanrique, Ciudad Real, Castilla-La Mancha, Spain (Campos de Montiel).
8 pet-friendly bungalows (up to 16 adults), breakfast, Wi-Fi and swimming pool.
Also: exclusive use of the estate, small events, corporate team building, film and photo shoots, and red-legged partridge shooting at La Calerilla (organised by Alectoris Ibérica SL).

Official name and address (NAP):
Finca Los Collados de San Miguel, Camino de los Collados, km 4,4, 13343 Villamanrique (Ciudad Real), España
+34 608 543 681
info@loscolladosdesanmiguel.com

Book accommodation on Booking.com. Enquiries for shooting, events, companies and exclusive use: WhatsApp or the contact form.
